decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster system remains tightly aligned with the firm's core coolant-management portfolio and, having stayed on the market after launch, now looks even less likely to be withdrawn soon.
The coolant nozzle line complements the installed base, supports aftermarket and cross-selling business, and as a multi-model range is likely to stay in the portfolio.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is somewhat more peripheral than the core coolant products, but it still fits the firm's broader material-flow and production-support offering well enough to retain it.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor builds directly on the firm's established chip-handling business and supports integrated solutions for metalworking customers, so it should remain available.

The hinged belt chip conveyor is an adjacent but commercially sensible variant in a broad machinery portfolio, and a large German supplier would usually keep it unless performance clearly disappointed.
